video_title: Tony Allen and Zach Randolph learn how COLD Julius Irving and Darryl Dawkins were 🔥

quotes.speaker: Zach Randolph
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach Randolph on Julius Erving's underrated greatness
quotes.excerpt: He was one of the best. He doesn't get talked about enough today.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Allen
text_blocks.text: He was one of the best. He doesn't get talked about enough today.

quotes.social_post: Zach Randolph says Julius Erving does not get talked about enough today. He calls him one of the best to ever do it.

quotes.speaker: Zach Randolph
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryl Dawkins' physical dominance and intimidation on the court
quotes.excerpt: Doc was amazing. He was an amazing offensive player who could get to the rack.

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Randolph
text_blocks.text: No, it wasn't no finger roll. It was coming in there and look you in the face and move and then turn back and dunk it in your face. No, Doc was amazing. He was an amazing offensive player who could get to the rack.

quotes.social_post: Zach Randolph remembers Darryl Dawkins as an amazing offensive player who would look you in the face before dunking on you.

quotes.speaker: Zach Randolph
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach Randolph reflects on losing to Magic Johnson in the Finals
quotes.excerpt: We beat Boston and go to the Finals and we lose to the Lakers, that was Magic Johnson's 42 and 15.
quotes.quote: The first year I came, we beat Boston and go to the Finals and we lose to the Lakers, that was Magic Johnson's 42 and 15. So the next year, I break my hand. We were playing Atlanta and Tree Rollins elbowed me and I punched him in the head and broke my hand. I told you I was a fighter back then.
quotes.social_post: Zach Randolph reflects on his early career and a physical altercation with Tree Rollins that led to a broken hand.

quotes.speaker: Zach Randolph
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach Randolph recalls his physical play against Darryl Dawkins
quotes.excerpt: I came to the basket, I jump and he comes and I pass it and he came down and pork chopped me.
quotes.quote: I came to the basket, I jump and he comes and I pass it and he came down and pork chopped me right across the nose and the nose bleed. I just turned around and fired on him and then he chased me. And then the whole Atlanta Hawks team is chasing me so I fake and go to the left and Daryl Dawkins intercepted him.
quotes.social_post: Zach Randolph recalls a wild story from his playing days involving a nose bleed and a chase involving the entire Atlanta Hawks team.

quotes.speaker: Zach Randolph
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach Randolph's assessment of Darryl Dawkins as a player
quotes.excerpt: I put him right up there with all any of the small forwards.
quotes.quote: Doc says if I hadn't broken my hand we probably would have won the title that year. But it didn't happen. I love Doc as a person, he's one of the best people I've played with. But as a player, you got to think about it, he left a lot of his game in the ABA before he got to the NBA. I put him right up there with all any of the small forwards. Now Larry Bird shot better than him, but they competed against each other on equal footing.
quotes.social_post: Zach Randolph puts Darryl Dawkins up there with the best small forwards, noting that he left a lot of his game in the ABA before reaching the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Zach Randolph
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryl Dawkins' personality and humor off the court
quotes.excerpt: He should have been a comedian. He was funny as could be.
quotes.quote: He should have been a comedian. He was funny as could be. We'd be on the bus, because we took the bus to Jersey, we took the bus to DC, took the bus to New York, and he would be in the back of the bus just telling stories and making everybody laugh. I can't even repeat the stories that he was telling. But he would get on the coaches and everybody. He was crazy. And he could sing. Right at our Christmas party, he started, he made up a song and sang it to the owner's wife at the Christmas party. You got Shaq who's funny, Shaq is not even in the category of Doc.
quotes.social_post: Zach Randolph says Darryl Dawkins was funnier than Shaq. He claims Dawkins should have been a comedian because he was constantly making the team laugh.

quotes.speaker: Zach Randolph
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryl Dawkins' specific on-court instructions to teammates
quotes.excerpt: Throw me the ball and get out of the way. Don't stand there and let your man help.
quotes.quote: Doc was like this: Throw me the ball and get out of the way. Don't stand there and let your man help cut through and get out of there. And we were running a play one night and I threw the ball in to Doc. He turns around and scores. We come back, throw it in to Doc, he turns around and scores. Next time, they leave Bobby Jones and come over to help before I even threw it, so I pump faking the guy started and I threw it to Bobby, Bobby scores the layup.
quotes.social_post: Zach Randolph breaks down the simple offensive strategy when playing with Darryl Dawkins: throw him the ball and get out of the way.

quotes.speaker: Zach Randolph
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryl Dawkins' reaction to not receiving the ball
quotes.excerpt: Daryl walks to the sideline to the other team and he said, Can you believe he didn't throw me the ball?
quotes.quote: Daryl walks to the sideline to the other team and he said, Can you believe he didn't throw me the ball? I had made three in a row and he didn't throw me the damn ball. And I come over there to try to calm him down and he get off me right in front of the other, he just embarrassed me in front of the other team.
quotes.social_post: Zach Randolph shares a story about Darryl Dawkins getting so frustrated about not getting the ball that he complained to the opposing team during the game.

quotes.speaker: Zach Randolph
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach Randolph on the intensity of team training camps
quotes.excerpt: We had a full house every day at training camp.
quotes.quote: Fast forward to next year we're in training camp and we had crowds at training camp. We had a full house every day at training camp. It was open every day. And so we're scrimmaging and I come down and I go and make a shot and Daryl's like, Man, I was open, pass me the ball. I said, You can get a whole lot of shots if you get offensive rebound. Man, why you screaming on me in front of all these people? Right. And so practice is, we go to locker room and we're in like this college and there's all these rows of lockers, so I'm coming out of the shower and there's Daryl. Of course, he'd be, if he wanted to, you know, he could just grab me around the neck and just punch me four or five times and let me drop, right? And so and that's when he said, Man, you man, don't don't don't humiliate me like that man in front of everybody. I said, Daryl, you don't remember last year when we were playing in the playoffs and you did this? Man, I sorry. He apologized to me. And then I was like, I was right ready to dance. Then I thought, okay, you you ain't that tough, right?
quotes.social_post: Zach Randolph recalls a tense training camp confrontation with Darryl Dawkins where he stood his ground after being told not to humiliate him in front of the team.

quotes.speaker: Zach Randolph
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach Randolph's opinion on Darryl Dawkins' potential in the modern NBA
quotes.excerpt: Daryl should have been in the league now. I played against Shaq, we coached against Shaq.
quotes.quote: Daryl should have been in the league now. I played against Shaq, we coached against Shaq. Shaq had 12 fouls in a game in Orlando his rookie year. They called three. He fouling everybody. Daryl look at somebody and they call a foul because Daryl would go cuss the referee out. He'd talk about their mother and everybody else, right? So so the refs going to call whatever on him. But if Daryl had come in the in now where they they protect the young guy and let him play, Daryl would have been a superstar.
quotes.social_post: Zach Randolph believes Darryl Dawkins would have been a superstar in the modern NBA because the league protects players more than it did back then.
